children: [AD HOC ANNOUNCEMENT PURSUANT TO ART. 53 LR] ROCHE ANNOUNCES POSITIVE PHASE II RESULTS FOR DUAL GLP-1/GIP RECEPTOR AGONIST ENICEPATIDE IN PEOPLE LIVING WITH TYPE 2 DIABETES AND OVERWEIGHT OR OBESITY
ANNOUNCES POSITIVE PHASE II RESULTS FOR ENICEPATIDE (CT-388)
ENICEPATIDE 24 MG REDUCES HBA1C BY 4.13% AT 48 WEEKS IN POOR CONTROL PATIENTS
TO INITIATE PHASE III GLYCEMIC-CONTROL AND CARDIOVASCULAR OUTCOMES TRIALS IN H1 2027
90% OF ENICEPATIDE 24 MG PATIENTS MET HBA1C ≤6.5% AT 48 WEEKS; 62% ACHIEVED NORMOGLYCEMIA
ENICEPATIDE SHOWS SAFETY PROFILE CONSISTENT WITH INCRETIN CLASS, NO NEW SAFETY SIGNALS
